ko.title: LLM 시스템 엔지니어링: 모델, 하드웨어, 워크로드를 연결하는 일
ko.description: 모델·하드웨어·워크로드로 실행 시스템을 이해하는 관점과 시리즈의 학습 순서를 소개합니다.

en.title: LLM Systems Engineering: Connecting Models, Hardware, and Workloads
en.description: An introduction to understanding execution systems through models, hardware, and workloads, and the learning path for this series.
en.reviewNote: Korean and English bodies compared for publication on 2026-09-08; model, hardware, workload definitions and learning roadmap match.

ko.title: LLM의 전체 구조: 임베딩 층에서 LM Head까지
ko.description: 텍스트가 토큰 ID와 벡터를 거쳐 어휘별 점수로 바뀌는 흐름과 임베딩 층, 디코더 블록, LM Head의 역할을 살펴봅니다.

en.title: The Structure of an LLM: From the Embedding Layer to the LM Head
en.description: Follow text through token IDs, vectors, and vocabulary scores, and explore the roles of the embedding layer, decoder blocks, and LM Head.
en.reviewNote: Compared Korean and English text section by section on 2026-09-09. Token IDs, dimensions, lookup order, context explanation, and logits semantics match; five English figures share the Korean geometry and illustrative values.

ko.title: 디코더 블록의 기본 흐름: Residual과 RMSNorm
ko.description: Residual stream을 중심으로 디코더 블록의 구조를 살펴보고, d차원 벡터의 덧셈과 RMSNorm의 계산을 설명합니다.

en.title: The Flow Through a Decoder Block: Residual Connections and RMSNorm
en.description: Explore a decoder block around its residual stream, then follow vector addition and RMSNorm across each token’s d components.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections and figure descriptions with the Korean source on 2026-09-09. Residual paths, dimensions, RMS/epsilon/gamma explanations and final normalization agree. English figures preserve the Korean geometry and numerical examples.

ko.title: Attention과 MLP: 토큰 사이의 정보와 토큰 내부의 변환
ko.description: Attention과 MLP의 역할을 비교하고, 행렬 곱부터 기본 MLP와 Gated MLP의 내부 계산까지 살펴봅니다.

en.title: Attention and MLP: Information Across Tokens and Transformations Within a Token
en.description: Compare Attention and MLP, then explore matrix multiplication and the computations inside basic and gated MLPs.
en.reviewNote: Compared all five sections, examples, symbols, alt text, and the closing paragraph with the approved Korean source on 2026-09-09. All five English figures retain the Korean geometry and numerical values, including the latest wording and deletions in Figure 1.

ko.title: Attention의 projection: Q·K·V와 멀티 헤드
ko.description: Q·K·V projection과 멀티 헤드의 구성을 살펴보고, 출력 projection이 같은 토큰의 여러 head 결과를 조합하는 과정을 설명합니다.

en.title: Attention Projections: Q, K, V and Multiple Heads
en.description: Explore Q, K and V projections, the organization of multiple heads, and how the output projection combines head results for the same token.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections, symbols, dimensions, emphasis, figure alt text and the closing paragraph with the approved Korean source on 2026-09-09. Token independence, full-input projections and head mixing match. All four English figures preserve the Korean geometry and example dimensions; both language versions were visually inspected.
